answers.answer: Build 3 small horse-themed maps, each sized for a single round and easy player navigation.

scene_prompt: Create three small, bright cartoon horse-themed farm maps, each sized for a single round with clear, easy-to-navigate routes. Include farm settings with horse areas and other animals as environmental features, keeping the spaces open and readable.
agent_notes: Murder Mystery 2 is the asymmetric one-is-"it" chase the 1 vs All preset is built for, so Survival leads on warren-looping, whose zero-dead-ends topology is the structural law that keeps a fleeing innocent from being cornered — that P6 is not negotiable. Party & Casual is named second because the round-and-lobby loop is genuinely its territory and it supplies social-hub for the space players gather in between rounds. Dropped the preset's gate-escape since this mode has no exit to reach — the round ends on the timer or when the sheriff drops the murderer — and kept spawn-protected only as evenly distributed round start points rather than separated hunter-and-hunted spawns, because a murder mystery depends on the killer starting hidden among the innocents. The three small single-round maps the scale answer asks for are genuinely separate maps, which is the P4; the animals become npc-population as ambient farm livestock, the look is the bright cartoon farm the theme answer chose, and I left stable and barn interiors out rather than assuming the P3 that entering them would cost.
